# StarNode (星诺)

> Local-first, browser-based personal knowledge manager that visualizes notes as a 3D "knowledge universe" of planets and gravitational links. Each note is a knowledge particle; clusters form planets; semantic similarity becomes visible gravity. Built with Next.js + TypeScript, monorepo with `core` (domain + linking algorithm), `renderer` (3D), `storage` (local persistence + migrations).

This is an *experimental* knowledge-management tool for people who feel that "I write a lot of notes but I can never find anything and the structure is invisible." StarNode tries to make that structure literally visible and navigable in 3D, with **explainable** link evidence — every "these two notes are related" assertion can be drilled into to see *which tag*, *which keyword*, or *which score* triggered it.

## What StarNode is

- A **local-first** personal knowledge-management web app (notes live in browser `localStorage`)
- A **3D universe view** of those notes, grouped into "planets" by user-defined categories
- An **explainable linking engine**: tag-based + keyword-based + semantic-similarity, with the evidence panel always visible
- A **monorepo**: Next.js shell (`apps/web`), pure domain logic + linking (`packages/core`), 3D rendering (`packages/renderer`), local persistence + migration (`packages/storage`)
- **Engineering-quality-gated**: lint / test / typecheck / build all required to pass, with explicit "Build Safety Gate" preventing unsafe production builds

## What StarNode is NOT (yet)

- ❌ Not a cloud sync service. Closing browser data wipes notes unless backed up.
- ❌ Not a replacement for Obsidian / Roam / Logseq for daily writing yet — MVP focuses on visualizing relationships.
- ❌ Not a Markdown vault. Notes are stored as structured records, not `.md` files.
- ❌ Not multi-user. Single-user, single-device by design.
- ❌ Not an AI assistant. No embedded LLM calls yet (linking is rule-based + scored, not embedding-based).

## Common questions

- **Where are my notes stored?** Browser `localStorage` under key `starnode:notes`. Clear browsing data → notes gone. Back them up via the ops manual.
- **Does it work offline?** Yes. After the first load, the SPA is fully usable without network.
- **Can I sync across devices?** Not yet — the v0.1 / v2026.x line is single-device. Sync is on the roadmap but explicitly deferred until the local experience is solid.
- **How are notes linked?** Three signals: explicit tags, keyword extraction from content, similarity scoring. Every link can be inspected to see which signal contributed how much.
- **Why 3D? Isn't that just for show?** The 3D view is the indexing UI, not a gimmick. Clusters of related notes form planets; the spatial position is meaningful (closer = more strongly linked).
- **What's the difference from Obsidian Graph view?** Obsidian's graph is 2D and shows hard `[[wikilinks]]`. StarNode is 3D, groups by planet (your own taxonomy), and surfaces *inferred* links with evidence — you don't have to author `[[links]]` for the connection to exist.
